findings.why: The `name` parameter is used to construct a file path without any sanitization, allowing attackers to traverse directories and potentially access sensitive files.
The `host` parameter is directly passed to a shell command without any validation or sanitization, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the server.
The `url` parameter is fetched server-side without any validation or allowlist, allowing attackers to perform SSRF attacks and potentially access internal resources.
